videos.title: #1 Principles of Islamic Finance - ACCA / CPA / SFM -By Saheb Academy
videos.summary: Unlike conventional banking where lenders profit off debt regardless of borrower success, Islamic finance operates on a radical partnership model where real economic value and mutual risk sharing replace exploitative interest. This concise breakdown unpacks the core Sharia-compliant principles that govern a multi-trillion-dollar global market, revealing why speculative instruments like derivatives and futures are strictly barred. If you want to understand how asset-backed wealth creation ethically aligns lender and borrower interests, this video delivers the complete foundational blueprint.

timestamps.topic: Why charging and paying interest (Riba) is strictly prohibited
The ban on excessive speculation (Maisir) in derivatives and options
The risk-sharing model between lender and borrower in place of fixed returns
